outcome: surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at Mekelle public hospitals, Northern Ethiopia, between July 2018 and July 2020.
finding: Ruptured membranes before cesarean delivery, prolonged operation time, estimated blood loss greater than 500 mL, and postoperative hemoglobin levels less than 11 g/dL were significant determinants of post-cesarean delivery surgical site infection.
